skills.name: project-plan
skills.description: Use when the user states a goal, a project or a piece of work to organise and wants a plan, milestones, a task list, a schedule or a risk review. Produces a plan file that can be followed and updated.

skills.name: manage-actions
skills.description: Use when the user wants something done later, again and again, or whenever something happens on the machine — "every morning", "remind me tomorrow", "each Monday", "warn me when a sign-in fails", "when an agent fails, look into it", "after an update". Creates, reviews and deletes Allkin's actions, at a time or on an event of the event log.
